scope: Static documentation index, not a worker API or execution authorization.
prerequisites: The source experiment path requires Git, Node.js 24+ and macOS sandbox-exec. Hosted documentation and recorded evidence do not require a worker account.
discoveryNote: Run from the trusted, built checkout you intend to use. Read each command's help. Discovery describes effects; it does not grant authority or prove worker readiness.

tasks.title: Run your first experiment
tasks.description: Reproduce a two-generation search with fixed workers. No model account is needed; the demo creates local files and executes sandboxed code.
tasks.label: Reproduce the demo

tasks.title: Inspect before dispatch
tasks.description: Read campaign state, resource configuration and delivery receipts before choosing the next action. Healthy records are not proof of authenticated workers.
tasks.label: Open the agent command guide

tasks.title: Allocate worker capacity
tasks.description: Commission supported native accounts or local models, preserve your personal reserve, and verify an explicit resource configuration.
tasks.label: Configure resources

tasks.title: Run bounded campaigns
tasks.description: Turn an objective into competing variants with fixed evaluation, resource limits and recorded outcomes. Continue improving inside the delegated budget.
tasks.label: Set up a campaign

tasks.title: Deliver and reconcile
tasks.description: Use an explicit delivery plan for local branches. Reconcile completed campaign receipts without rerunning workers; a branch is not a production release.
tasks.label: Follow the delivery contract

tasks.title: Improve the system
tasks.description: Understand the local kernel and independent ecosystem projects. Use useful accepted changes per token and hour as the target—not activity alone.
tasks.label: Read the North Star

interpretation: Inspect structured outcomes, not exit code alone. A healthy check can still describe a held or completed campaign.
Valid resource configuration is not an authenticated connection or proof of remaining provider quota.
Keep campaign completion, evaluated usefulness, local delivery and production acceptance distinct.
Keep roots, target branches, budgets and operator reserves explicit. Do not publish raw startup tokens or private runtime records.

evidence.measurementScope: Deterministic local experiment, not measured AI engineering yield.
